name: DAG (Dense Adversary Generation, Xie et al., ICCV 2017)
description: Ascends sum over still-correct voxels of [logit(adversarial label) - logit(true label)], with the gradient normalised by its L-inf norm to a step gamma. No random start; stops early once every voxel is fooled. gamma = eps/n_steps and the iterate is projected onto the eps-ball (deviations from the unbounded gamma=0.5-on-[0,255] paper setting).
